title: AwesomeMessages
description: Allows server admins to customize and disable server join and leave messages (with possibly more to come!)
body:
# AwesomeMessages

AwesomeMessages is a 1.21.x Paper/Spigot plugin that allows server operators to change or disable player join and leave messages. It supports MiniMessage as well as legacy color codes.

I made this plugin simply because I noticed that there weren't a lot of plugins that allowed you to change player join and leave messages, and I hope to fill that gap.


<details>
<summary>Spoiler</summary>

Commands:

- /amreload - Reloads the plugin

Permissions:

- am.reload - Allows usage of the /amreload command.

</details>
